slides.headline: 5 FREE PROMPTS THAT REPLACE YOUR ENTIRE PR FIRM TONIGHT
1) WRITE A CRISIS RESPONSE IN 3 MINUTES FLAT
slides.body: A PR crisis consultant charges $300 an hour, and won't pick up Friday night. Prompt: "I run [business]. Here is what happened: [situation]. Write a public statement under 150 words, no legal fault admitted."

slides.headline: 2) WRITE A PRESS RELEASE ANY JOURNALIST WILL OPEN
slides.body: Agencies charge $1,500 to $3,000 per press release, you keep the $2,500. Prompt: "Write a press release. Business: [describe]. The news: [announcement]. Format: headline under 12 words, dateline, two paragraphs, boilerplate, contact info."

slides.headline: $144,000
slides.body: What a mid-size company pays a PR agency on annual retainer. Every prompt in this post covers something in that invoice

slides.headline: 3) PITCH A JOURNALIST WITHOUT GETTING IGNORED
slides.body: PR agencies charge $500 to $1,500 to write a pitch journalists delete. Prompt: "Write 3 subject lines and a 5-sentence email opening with why their readers care, not my company. Business: [describe]. News: [describe]."

slides.headline: 4) BUILD A BRAND STORY ANY REPORTER CAN RETELL
slides.body: Media consultants charge $2,000 to $5,000 to package a founder's story. Prompt: "Write my brand origin story for press. Business: [describe]. The problem I experienced: [describe]. What changed: [example with a number]."

slides.headline: 5) TRACK WHAT PEOPLE SAY AND RESPOND IN SECONDS
slides.body: Reputation monitoring software runs $200 to $400 a month. Prompt: "Act as my brand analyst. Paste reviews below. Classify sentiment, rate urgency, and draft a 2-sentence reply for every negative item. Business: [describe]."

caption:
Swipe for 5 AI prompts that cover what PR firms charge $144,000 a year for. 🧠

Crisis response statement in under 3 minutes, press release formatted the way journalists expect, journalist cold pitch that leads with their readers not your company, brand origin story built for press and media, reputation monitoring with triage and drafted replies for every negative mention.

Forbes called it this week: employers are cutting expensive external contracts first. PR retainers are going. Businesses replacing $10,000-a-month agencies with AI prompts that run in seconds are keeping that money.
Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.
